title: NextLevel Academy
description: An integrated web platform that provide high-quality education/courses, that combines a self-paced video LMS with a gamification system featuring level-based incentives and vouchers, as well as a server-time-based virtual internship infrastructure to digitize the operations of the startup NextLevel Academy.

title: HOSEKI SHOPS
description: Built a fullstack multi-service e-commerce platform from scratch to learn, implement, and master modern Docker containerization, Kubernetes cluster orchestration, and automated CI/CD pipelines.

title: Predictive Maintenance Failure Classification & Anomaly Detection
description: Two-layer detection system for industrial sensor data. An XGBoost classifier identifies known failure types while an Isolation Forest catches unseen anomaly patterns. Deployed as an interactive real-time dashboard.

title: Contexure - RAG AI Chatbot
description: Contexure is an enterprise-grade, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) conversational platform purpose-built for industrial automation engineers, field technicians, and system integrators who interact with complex technical datasheets (AC motors, variable frequency drives, PLCs, inductive sensors).
